sentence: Driven by an underlying perfectionism and sympathy-seeking need, Carcinosin is engaged in a relentless oscillation between fastidious control, emotional sensitivity, and periodic release through passion, rhythm, or travel.
references: Gruber, F. MD. 'The Cycle of Carcinosin.' New England Journal of Homeopathy, Vol 5 #4.
Herscu, P. & Rothenberg, A. NESH curriculum materials.

segments.name: Perfectionism and fastidiousness
segments.description: Excessive need for order, cleanliness, precision. Everything must be just so. Punctual, conscientious, over-responsible. Anxiety if things are out of place. Pedantic.

segments.name: Sensitivity and sympathy seeking
segments.description: Intensely sensitive to criticism, reprimand, or suffering. Easily offended. Seeks sympathy, compassion, and reassurance. Weeps when thanked. Emotional vulnerability.

segments.name: Passion and intensity
segments.description: Intense, passionate nature. Strong attachment to loved ones. Great love for animals. Artistic, creative, intense emotional expression. May be theatrical or dramatic.

segments.name: Rhythm and repetition
segments.description: Need for rhythm, repetition, routine. May dance, rock, or pace. Strong connection to music. Sleep disturbances worse at full moon. Worse from suppressing natural urges. History of repetitive behaviors.

segments.name: Wanderlust and need for travel
segments.description: Strong desire to travel, to move, to change scenery. Restlessness, cannot stay in one place. Desire for adventure, new experiences. Feels confined, trapped if stationary.
segments.next_segment: Fear of cancer and disease history

segments.name: Fear of cancer and disease history
segments.description: Anxiety about cancer, tumors, serious illness. Strong family history of cancer or tuberculosis. History of severe diseases in childhood. Fears death, fears hospitals. Hypochondriacal tendencies.
